gdp_yoy.source: MoSPI Press Note on Provisional Estimates of GDP for Q4 FY2025-26 (Jan-Mar 2026) and PE for FY2025-26, released June 5, 2026. Q4 FY26 grew 7.8% YoY, down from 8.0% in Q3 FY26; full-year FY26 growth revised to 7.7%. Next release (Q1 FY27 / First Revised Estimates) due August 31, 2026 — not yet published as of this refresh.

cpi.source: MoSPI Press Release of Consumer Price Index on Base 2024=100 for July 2026 (embargoed until 4 PM, August 12, 2026). Headline CPI inflation 4.45% (rural 4.84%, urban 3.96%), up from 4.38% in June 2026 — highest since December 2024. Food inflation 5.52% YoY.

gsec10y.source: India 10-Year G-Sec benchmark yield (CCIL data via Trading Economics/Business Standard): yield rose from ~6.76% on Aug 14, 2026 to ~6.87-6.91% by Aug 28, 2026, near a two-month high, amid hawkish RBI August MPC minutes reviving rate-hike expectations and caution ahead of heavy government debt supply.

rate_cut_cycle.note: RBI MPC held repo rate unchanged at 5.25% on August 5, 2026 (fourth consecutive hold), maintaining a neutral stance. Governor Sanjay Malhotra cited a need for 'greater clarity' on the inflation outlook before further action. Hawkish minutes from this meeting subsequently revived market expectations of a possible rate hike later in the year. Next MPC meeting scheduled October 5-7, 2026.
rate_cut_cycle.source: RBI Monetary Policy Committee Resolution, August 5, 2026 (via Business Standard, Forbes India, Outlook Money MPC coverage).

gov_capex.note: Centre achieved ~28% of its FY27 capex target of ₹12.22 lakh crore by end of Q1 (Apr-Jun 2026), per CGA data; capex spending up 66% YoY in June alone. Separately, 63 CPSEs met 25% of their cumulative FY27 capex target in Q1, with capex up 26% YoY to ₹2.10 lakh crore. Capex-led growth push remains on track for FY27.
gov_capex.source: Controller General of Accounts (CGA) capex data via Business Standard 'CPSEs meet 25% of FY27 cumulative capital expenditure target in Q1' (July 6, 2026) and thepamphlet.in CGA coverage.

china_plus_one.note: India's cumulative exports for Apr-Jun FY27 rose 11.37% YoY to $232.73bn, with merchandise exports up 15.92% led by strong engineering and electronics growth — consistent with continued manufacturing/export diversification under the China+1 thesis. PLI-driven electronics FDI remains active (~$4bn cumulative since FY21, ~70% from PLI beneficiaries).
china_plus_one.source: PIB Ministry of Commerce & Industry press release on Apr-Jun 2026-27 export data (July 13, 2026); PIB Electronics Components Manufacturing Scheme / PLI releases.

rural_recovery.note: Kharif sowing gap narrowed to just 1.5% below last year's level as of Aug 21, 2026 (from ~23% deficit in late June), and cumulative monsoon rainfall deficit reduced to ~11.5% below LPA by Aug 1. However, IMD still forecasts below-normal rainfall (under 94% of LPA) for Aug-Sep amid El Niño conditions, and reservoir storage (44% of capacity) remains below historical average in several basins. Improving from earlier 'weak' reading but not yet a clear positive signal.
rural_recovery.source: Business Standard 'Kharif sowing reaches near-2025 levels, just 1.5% lower till August 21' (Aug 24, 2026); USDA FAS GAIN report 'India: Monsoon Recovery Fails to Boost Sluggish Crop Planting' (August 2026); ICRA Mid-Monsoon Update August 2026.
